But first, I want to say: in Thailand, you don't need to go to fine-dining restaurants to eat high-quality, fresh, delicious, and affordable food—you can find it all in the street markets. I truly admire how they serve such accessible yet world-class dishes. Here are the reasons for my ratings: 1. Famous Mango Smoothie (10/10) - You can actually find mango smoothies anywhere, but Thailand’s mangoes are exceptional. Plus, Thailand grows so many incredible varieties of mango! 2. Grasshopper (1/10) - I know not everyone in Thailand eats insects; it’s a personal preference, and it just wasn't for me. I realize 1 is a really low score, so if this offended anyone, I sincerely apologize! I’m just rating based on my own palate. 3. Tom Yum Gai (10/10) - Sweet, salty, spicy, and sour—all in one bowl. I think one of the things that sets Thai cuisine apart is how seamlessly it harmonizes completely different flavors. - A must-try in Thailand! - 4. Coconut Pancake (6-7/10) - A lot of people love coconut pancakes, but they just don't appeal to me as much. I’d personally prefer Tom Kha Gai (coconut Tom Yum soup) or a nice coconut cake instead. 5. Pad Thai (10/10) - One of the ultimate stars of Thai cuisine. When you get it from a place that knows how to make it right, it’s so satisfying! - Another must-try in Thailand! - 6. Santol Salad (100/10) - Santol is my absolute favorite fruit in Thailand. It’s so underrated, but I really want to hype it up! ⚡️ Santol salad is amazing, and eating santol completely on its own as a fruit is just as great. I hope you enjoyed the video! Veterinary professionals have one of the highest suicide rates of any profession. At the same time, many others are leaving veterinary medicine altogether. There isn’t one single reason why, but one thing I wish more people understood is the emotional toll of being told you’re “only in it for the money” or accused of trying to manipulate people simply because you ask for payment for medical care. Veterinary clinics are businesses with staff to pay, equipment to maintain, medications to stock, and hospitals to keep open. None of that changes when a patient is critically ill. Every veterinarian I know wishes every pet could receive every treatment they need regardless of cost, but wanting that and actually being able to provide it for free are two very different things. Before assuming the worst, remember that the person on the other side of the exam table has likely dedicated years of their life, accumulated significant educational debt, and carries the weight of difficult decisions every single day. 👉🏻콜라겐이 나쁜가? → ❌
 -  콜라겐은 피부, 뼈, 연골 등의 구성 성분으로, 피부와 관절 건강에 도움을 줄 수 있는 단백질입니다.
 -  피부나 관절 건강이 목적이라면 섭취하는 것이 도움이 될 수 있습니다.
 👉🏻콜라겐도 단백질인데 근육 합성에 도움이 될까? → ❌
 -  근육 단백질 합성을 위해서는 류신(Leucine)이 풍부한 단백질이 유리합니다.
 -  대표적으로 분리유청단백(WPI), 농축유청단백(WPC), 우유단백(MPC), 분리대두단백(ISP) 등이 있습니다.
 -  콜라겐은 류신 함량이 매우 낮고 필수아미노산 구성이 근육 합성에 적합하지 않아, 근육을 키우는 목적의 단백질로는 효율이 낮습니다.
 👉🏻이렇게 표기하는 것이 불법인가? → ❌
 -  콜라겐도 단백질이므로 단백질 원료로 표기하는 것 자체는 위법이 아닙니다.
 -  다만 근육을 위한 단백질 제품으로 기대하고 구매하는 소비자라면, 어떤 단백질이 얼마나 들어있는지 원재료를 확인하는 것이 중요합니다.
 ✨내 단백질 쉐이크가 좋은 단백질로 이루어져있는지 확인하는 방법
 -  원재료명에서 첫 번째 또는 두 번째 원재료에 콜라겐펩타이드가 있는지 확인하기
 -  단백질 원료가 하나의 혼합원료로만 표시되어 있는지 확인하기
   예를 들어 “○○믹스(콜라겐펩타이드, 분리대두단백 등)“ 처럼 표기되어 있으면 각 원료의 비율을 알기 어렵습니다.
 -  근육 합성이 목적이라면 다음과 같은 단백질이 포함되어 있는지 확인하기 : 농축유청단백(WPC), 분리유청단백(WPI), 우유단백(MPC), 분리대두단백(ISP)
